scope: Read-only source audit for native transcript replacement; no production changes or new transcript runtime verification in this audit.
reviewedNativeState: MainWindow still uses one QTextBrowser, transcriptHtml, m_streams and m_toolEvents. Root is designing a separate ConversationView; findings describe the pre-replacement implementation.
evidenceType: Source-inspected contracts and source-inspected gaps. Existing tests are noted separately; this is not a visual or exact-parity certification.

contracts.behavior: Assistant messages render ordered text, reasoning, tool and file parts. Consecutive reasoning and tools classified for exploration presentation are grouped; step-start is skipped. Original part indices are preserved for timing metadata. Stable message/group/type keys prevent settled content from being recreated on every stream update.

ThinkingPart initially expands when streaming or last. Streaming automatically expands it. When no longer last it collapses unless manually expanded. The hook records manual expansion separately; its exact dependency transitions are narrower than the comment 'always respect manual collapse', so a native implementation must test transitions rather than infer a blanket collapse policy. Header is Thinking... while streaming, Thought for Ns when done with nonzero measured duration, otherwise Thought. Duration is rounded milliseconds/1000 from per-part metadata. Body uses streaming Markdown at 75% opacity; an optional cap is 96px.

Exploration presentation includes reasoning, glob, grepSearch, read, ls, searchInLibraryDocs, listLibraryDocs, executeSandboxJs, readConsoleLogs and getLintingDiagnostics. This list is a UI grouping rule, not an authorization or security classification. Headers summarize completed operations and show the active operation. Single parts may render inline. Groups cap content at 240px, or 384px when a child is manually expanded.

Dedicated renderers distinguish inputs streaming, inputs available, approval requested/responded, output denied, output available and output error where the tool supports those states. Compact completed rows use the tool icon and finished label; errors use an X, truncated diagnostic and tooltip. Shell cards include command/explanation/output, inline approve/deny, session cancellation, and Smart allow through the actual policy API. Generic unavailable tool names use a fallback. Native code must not expose Smart allow, cancel or file restore controls until their operations exist.

Write/multi-edit rendering can show streamed partial code, completed before/after diffs, addition/deletion counts and open/reveal actions. Completed mutating calls can be summarized by a turn-file-edits component, with individual parts initially collapsed. Error output is not a successful diff. File restoration is a separate backed action requiring actual checkpoint data.

TextPart sends the full current part text directly to Streamdown with isStreaming. The wrapper selects streaming/static mode, light-plus/dark-plus highlighting, KaTeX math, custom code/cards/tables/links/images and Mermaid rendering. It preprocesses incomplete trailing path/color/tab attachment links and balanced color URLs. Do not infer the complete dependency Markdown algorithm from wrapper options alone.

Streaming code highlighting runs through a worker with 100ms debounce for up to 1000 characters and 800ms above that threshold. Mounted/version checks discard stale worker results. Escaped plain text is available before highlighting; worker failure is nonfatal. Copy control appears only once the code block is no longer streaming, copies the original code and shows confirmation for 2000ms.

An adaptive useTypeWriterText hook exists, but repository search of apps/browser/src found only its definition and no consumer. Active TextPart renders Streamdown directly. An added character-reveal delay would therefore be a native design choice, not a verified upstream behavior.
contracts.verification: rg -n 'useTypeWriter|useTypewriter|use-type-writer' upstream/stagewise/apps/browser/src returned only the hook definition.

contracts.behavior: User text is converted from Markdown to a rich read-only input representation and enriched with attachment metadata. It appears in a right-aligned bordered rounded bubble. When idle and the message has an ID, it can enter editing; Escape cancels. Only one edit is active, attachment identities are preserved, and editing messages with subsequent file changes can require confirmation. Native plain escaped text does not match this behavior.

The inspected assistant component exposes Restore checkpoint for non-last messages and confirmation when needed; no generic full-assistant copy button was found there. Code blocks and runtime diagnostics have verified copy actions. Custom path/color/tab links resolve attachments, ordinary links open the browser, and Alt-click can create a content tab. Images have open/download actions. These are distinct dispatch paths, not arbitrary navigation of every href.

Chat history is virtualized with react-virtuoso, stable message IDs, 400px viewport expansion above/below, and an initial position near the last two messages. Chat follows output initially. Upward wheel immediately disables following; upward scroll beyond 100px from bottom disables it; scroll-end within 100px enables it. Send and explicit jump-to-bottom force following. The jump button is visible while away from bottom. A measured spacer leaves room below the latest user message. Inner expanded tool cards use their own 20px threshold and do not initialize at bottom.

The last working unfinished message can show Still on it… after 5000ms without part changes. Between-step indicators avoid duplicate activity hints after settled text/reasoning or trailing exploration groups. Runtime errors render structured cards with provider/auth-specific actions, diagnostic copy and guarded retry paths, rather than only a transient status-label string.

nativeGaps.finding: All live text across model/tool rounds is concatenated into m_streams[id], while all tool events render before that string. The stored session history is refreshed only at overall finished. This cannot preserve live text -> tool -> text chronology or distinct assistant rounds.
nativeGaps.status: Source-proven data/model limitation; no dedicated rendering regression yet.

nativeGaps.finding: The engine emits reasoningDelta for all four protocol families but MainWindow does not subscribe, and transcriptHtml ignores reasoning_content and ade_native blocks. Reasoning is invisible both live and after reload. Pure reasoning-only terminal partial responses are also excluded by retainPartialResponse's text/tool guard.
nativeGaps.status: Source-proven; backend display retention needed as well as widgets.

nativeGaps.finding: Persisted tool records all display a checkmark and generic Tool result, including errors/denials; output is silently cut to 3000 characters. Live toolStarted ignores call ID/arguments; toolFinished discards output/error from transcript state. No call-linked approval/running/error cards exist.
nativeGaps.status: Source-proven. Join each result to its toolCallId; display truncation explicitly and retain full inspectable content under bounds.

nativeGaps.finding: Every render calls setHtml for the entire transcript. The 40ms timer coalesces only text updates; host/tool events render immediately. Collapse state, stable row identity and selection are absent. Preserving an absolute scrollbar value is not an anchor strategy when earlier content reflows.
nativeGaps.status: Source-proven architecture; performance and selection impact need measured tests.

nativeGaps.finding: Assistant Markdown uses QTextDocument's generic Markdown conversion. User content is escaped plain text. Attachments are only names. No custom code copy/highlight cards, math, Mermaid, partial attachment links, rich user mentions, image preview or source-specific link router exists.
nativeGaps.status: Source-inspected feature gaps; richer Markdown parity must be tracked separately from a first native component.

nativeGaps.finding: Native follow policy is only distance<70 before replacement. It has no explicit upward-wheel intent, jump-to-bottom, measured latest-user spacer, per-chat anchor/follow state or history virtualization.
nativeGaps.status: Source-proven control differences; add actual scrolling/layout tests.

nativeGaps.finding: Approval is a generic modal Yes/No box with JSON arguments. Runtime failures are status-label text. No inline approval, diagnostic card/retry, last-part stalled hint, user-message editing or checkpoint restoration UI is present.
nativeGaps.status: Source-inspected gaps; actions require real backend operations before exposing controls.

proposedNativeContract.status: Recommendation, not implemented by this audit.
proposedNativeContract.view: ConversationView QWidget with stable per-message and per-part native rows. Rich text documents belong to individual content parts; code, reasoning, tool, error and attachment cards have their own controls. A simple QScrollArea can establish a first component but is not equivalent to upstream virtualization for large histories.
proposedNativeContract.displaySnapshot: Read-only AgentEngine display snapshot containing retained messages plus at most one provisional assistant response when not already retained. Stable conversation/turn/message/part keys and a revision identify incremental changes. Join tool results by call ID; never concatenate separate rounds.
proposedNativeContract.ordering: Prefer ordered display parts derived from provider-native blocks where present. For generic OpenAI deltas, retain segment order as events arrive if reasoning/text interleaving must be exact. Do not rewrite or expose signed provider replay blobs as display metadata.
proposedNativeContract.state: Explicit per-part streaming/done state and per-tool input-streaming, approval, running, available, denied, error/cancelled state. Capture real monotonic start/end times if displaying durations; do not invent timing for imported history. Overall working/stalled/error status remains separate.
proposedNativeContract.notification: One displayChanged signal on text/reasoning/tool-argument fragments, new round, retained response, approval/result/cancel/failure transitions. Consumer coalesces roughly one frame, proposed 16ms, and reads the current snapshot; terminal transitions must not be lost by throttling.
proposedNativeContract.stateIsolation: Keep collapse and scroll state keyed by conversation and stable part ID. Handle owner deletion, chat switching, archive, fork and delayed timers using guarded ownership/generation. Preserve provider message replay independently.
proposedNativeContract.unsupportedFeatures: Mark remaining code/Markdown/math/Mermaid/diff/checkpoint/editing parity explicitly. Never show an action as working until its operation and failure path are wired.

existingTestCoupling.assertion: QTextBrowser named conversationView contains Native UI response after local provider completion.
Failed save does not expose Keep this unsaved prompt in the transcript.

testMigration: Replace these three direct QTextBrowser lookups with ConversationView::toPlainText or a stable public transcript inspection API. Keep objectName conversationView on the real component. Do not add hidden compatibility QTextBrowser widgets.
requiredRegressionCoverage: Ordered reasoning -> text -> tool -> text across multiple rounds, plus provider-native interleaving and stable call IDs.
Tool argument fragments before dispatch; approval requested/responded; denied, cancelled, failed and successful output without false success icons.
Provider reasoning live and persisted reload, with signed native replay unchanged; terminal partial reasoning retained for display.
Split Unicode and Markdown chunks, unclosed fences, changing partial links, code escaping, exact copied code and copy state after completion.
Reasoning auto-expand while streaming/last, auto-collapse after next part, manual expansion retained, explicit chosen manual-collapse semantics.
Live component updates do not reset unrelated expanded cards or selected text; switching/archive/delete drops stale scheduled updates.
Upward wheel and scrollbar stop following; content growth preserves an anchor; send/jump re-enables follow; collapsed/expanded cards respect inner scroll.
No duplicate provisional response after retention, no duplicate optimistic user after acceptance, and rejection keeps draft/history boundary.
Large-history row count/memory/reflow measurements and bounded latency, independently of correct small-fixture rendering.
Light/dark, 768px narrow content, font scaling and long code/path/error strings rendered and visually inspected.
Real action tests for file/path/tab links, approval, retry, copy and eventual checkpoint/edit, with unsupported actions absent.
limits: This audit reads pinned source; it does not run the Electron upstream renderer or establish screenshot pixel equality.

No upstream third-party dependency source was reverse engineered here. Declared browser dependencies include streamdown ^2.5.0, @streamdown/math ^1.0.2, react-virtuoso ^4.18.7 and shiki 3.21.0; wrapper behavior is the verified boundary.

The current history schema lacks stable UI message/part identities and typed terminal tool-state metadata. Legacy imports may need conservative derived display state; content prefixes are not authoritative structured error metadata.

A single native message component is necessary but insufficient for full transcript parity, especially rich user attachments/editing, mathematical/diagram rendering, virtualized history and checkpoint diffs.
